        RECRUITED

        Saved Heroes

        Open lobby
        • Save a fighter from either tournament format.
        Champion & Hero rules
        • Last season’s quarterfinalists and career #1–8 return directly. Career #9–10 start in the qualifier unless already direct.
        • Fighters can play for a win or a draw. Clock expiry is a draw. After three drawn bouts, one seed advances without a win, or the final closes without a title.
        • Save an SSS+ V Hero from the bracket or leaderboard, then select them in the match lobby. Tournament records and Heroes are kept in this browser.
        • Next bout simulates and records one matchup. Run bracket simulates every remaining bout. Stop keeps all completed results.
        Squad tournament rules
        • Each side fields five SSS+ V fighters. Last season’s quarterfinalists and career #1–8 return directly. Career #9–10 get a qualifier slot if they need one.
        • Fighters can play for a win or a draw. Clock expiry is a draw. After three drawn bouts, one seed advances without a win, or the final closes without a title.
        • New squads fill out the mix of All Female, All Male, and Mixed teams. Returning rosters stay together.
        • Team records and the 1v1 tournament are saved separately in this browser.
